expected_outputs: typed controlled donor evidence review pack

sources.content:
# Donor agreement and logframe extract supplied by customer

Reporting period: January-June 2026.
Indicator I2 target: 40 rehabilitated water points.
Final donor acceptance, grant-compliance conclusions and approval of the donor report remain with authorised humans.

This record supplies the target and reporting boundary only. It does not establish the number of completed sites or approve any donor representation.

rows: 37 completed sites supported by supplied engineering completion certificates

sources.content:
# Semi-annual donor narrative draft supplied by customer

Indicator I2 narrative claim: 41 rehabilitated water points completed during January-June 2026.

This is a draft narrative claim. It is not a donor-accepted representation and must be reconciled against the supplied engineering completion evidence before authorised reporting.

rows: invoice referenced by reporting records but no invoice attachment supplied

sources.content:
# Donor reporting review note supplied by customer

The customer requests a traceable semi-annual donor evidence pack. Engineering evidence supports 37 completed sites while the draft narrative states 41. A supplier invoice for R96,400 is referenced but the invoice itself is not supplied.

DIO must preserve these review conditions and may not determine donor eligibility, award funding, certify grant compliance, record donor acceptance or approve the final donor report.

requirements.statement: Reconcile Indicator I2 completion evidence against the donor narrative without selecting between the supplied 37-site evidence position and the 41-site draft claim.
Reconcile the supplied Workstream 2 expenditure evidence and surface the referenced R96,400 supplier invoice as missing rather than treating the ledger reference as the invoice itself.

issues.hypothesis: The supplied engineering completion evidence supports 37 rehabilitated water points while the donor narrative draft claims 41 completed sites for the same reporting period. Human donor review must preserve the 37-versus-41 discrepancy instead of silently reconciling it.

The supplied reporting records reference a supplier invoice for R96,400, but the invoice attachment itself is not supplied. Human donor review must not treat the ledger or invoice-reference register as a substitute for the missing invoice.
